meta.title: Travel Tools — Visa Expeditor
meta.description: Free tools to check visa requirements, passport validity and the documents you need before you travel.

hero.heading: Tools for Smoother Travel
hero.subhead: Check the details that cause most delays before you book, so nothing catches you out.

grid.heading: Choose a Tool
grid.subhead: Each tool focuses on one decision and points you to the right next step.

visaChecker.label: Visa Checker
visaChecker.description: See whether your passport needs a visa for a destination, based on our sample dataset.

passportValidity.label: Passport Validity Checker
passportValidity.description: Check whether your passport's expiry meets your destination's entry rules.

checklist.label: Document Checklist
checklist.description: Build a checklist of the documents your entry type usually needs.

passportPower.label: Passport Power
passportPower.description: See where your passport can take you, computed from our own dataset.

faqs.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
faqs.a1: Yes. The tools are free to use. If you later want help with an application, that is a separate service.
faqs.a2: No. Our tools use sample data for demonstration and are not official sources. Always confirm with the destination's authorities.
faqs.q3: Do the tools store my data?
faqs.a3: The passport validity checker runs in your browser. Other tools may save your passport choice in a cookie so the site remembers it.
faqs.q4: Can a tool tell me if I will be approved?
faqs.a4: No. Entry and visa decisions are made by authorities. Our tools only help you prepare and check details.
faqs.q5: What if a tool shows no data?
faqs.a5: Our dataset is still growing. Where we have no row, we say so rather than guess. Contact us and we will help directly.

cta.title: Need help after checking?
cta.body: If a tool raises a question, our team can explain what your destination expects.

meta.title: Passport Validity Checker — Visa Expeditor
meta.description: Check whether your passport's expiry date meets your destination's entry rules before you travel.

hero.heading: Passport Validity Checker
hero.subhead: Check whether your passport's expiry date meets your destination's entry rules.

overview.heading: What this tool does
overview.p1: Many countries require your passport to remain valid for a set period beyond your planned departure, often six months. A passport that is still in date can still be refused if it does not meet that rule.
overview.p2: This tool compares your passport expiry with your travel dates and the validity rule you select, so you can renew in time if needed.

whoFor.heading: Who this is for
whoFor.i1: Travelers checking a passport before booking flights.
whoFor.i2: Anyone whose passport expires within a year.
whoFor.i3: Families coordinating several passports at once.

s1.title: Enter your expiry date
s1.description: Use the date printed on your passport's expiry field.

s2.title: Enter your travel dates
s2.description: Add your planned departure and return dates.

s3.title: Choose the validity rule
s3.description: Select the rule your destination applies, or the common six-month rule if you are unsure.

s4.title: Read the result
s4.description: The tool tells you whether your passport appears to meet the rule, and what to do next.

r1.label: Expiry date
r1.value: The expiry date printed in your passport.

r2.label: Travel dates
r2.value: Your planned departure and return dates.

r3.label: Destination rule
r3.value: The minimum validity your destination requires, if you know it.

r4.label: A note of the result
r4.value: If your passport falls short, contact us about renewal options.

faqs.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
faqs.a1: It is a common requirement that a passport stay valid for six months beyond your planned departure. Not every country applies it.
faqs.a2: No. Some countries require three months, some six, and some only require validity through your stay. Confirm the rule for your destination.
faqs.q3: What if my passport expires during my trip?
faqs.a3: That is usually a problem. Renew before you travel if you can, and contact us to plan the timing.
faqs.a4: Processing times vary by country and season and change over time, so apply as early as you can.
faqs.a5: No. It is a helpful estimate. Always confirm requirements with the destination's official authorities before you travel.

cta.title: Passport expiring soon?
cta.body: If your passport does not meet the rule, talk to us about renewal options.
